items.title: Decide and execute literary-agent submission route
items.summary: After sufficient beta feedback, decide whether to pursue agents or KDP only; if agents are chosen, prepare and send queries to the named target agencies.
items.acceptance_outcome: A beta-evidence-based route decision is recorded and, if traditional representation is chosen, the agent submission package is sent to the identified agencies.
